feature: Filter sheet portal and delete-account sheet focus handling
note: This PR portals the mobile filter sheet to the body and adds a focus trap, Escape and focus return to the delete-account sheet. Those are DOM and keyboard behaviours a screenshot cannot show; they are covered by unit tests and a hand walk. These sheets prove only that the OPEN states still render at 320 and 390 in Electric, Light and Pulse after the change. All rows are read-only: the delete form is never filled or submitted. The /me delete-account row is in sheet-click-through-delete-me.json: /me re-applies the account's saved theme (Drip on this scratch account), so it runs one Drip pass.
